title: One safe-pattern checker for tenant regexes (SEC2-013, SEC2-014, SEC3-003)
story: As the platform operator I want every tenant-authored regex checked by one strict, tested checker at save time and at evaluation so that one admin cannot freeze the server for every tenant
acceptance: src/core/safe-pattern.mjs exports isSafePattern(src) implementing a strict whitelist grammar (literals, classes, anchors, bounded quantifiers {0,n} with n<=50 and at most one unbounded quantifier per alternation-free run, no backreferences, no nested quantifiers, no quantified groups containing alternation or optional bodies, max pattern length 200) and a matchWithBudget helper that caps input length at 200 chars for pattern checks

Rejected (test): (a|aa)+$, (a|a)*b, (\w|\d)+x$, (a+)+, ^a*a*a*a*a*a*b, .*.*.*.*.*x, (a?){30}a{30}. Accepted: the patterns used today in tenants/*.json (test loads both tenant files and checks every validation.pattern and every rule 'matches' value)

config/validator.js rejects an unsafe pattern at save time with a 422-style validation error naming the path; rules/condition.js and intake/questions.js both use the shared checker at evaluation; intake/security.js isSafePattern delegates to it
The SEC2-013 todo test (tests/security/sec2-availability-ai.test.mjs) passes when run locally (todo tests still run); do not edit tests/security
Each pathological pattern case in the tests finishes under 50 ms; tests/e2e and tests/security show no new failures
brief: src/core/ is Platform-owned; this one new file is granted to this squad ticket (posted to the decisions hub by the orchestrator). Keep it zero-dependency. Prefer a grammar parser over regex-on-regex heuristics. Check the existing heuristics at rules/condition.js:94-100 and intake/security.js:158-169 and remove duplication. Do not touch intake/service.js, routes.js (S5-WFL-01) or conversation.js (S5-AI-01).
